contre-courant.name: Undertow
contre-courant.description: Each opponent on the Gate Card loses twice the power it had gained above its base level

pacte-sanglant.name: Blood Pact
pacte-sanglant.description: Adds 200 Gs to the user, but if it loses this battle it is removed from the game for good and can never be revived

grace-salvatrice.name: Saving Grace
grace-salvatrice.description: Marks an allied Bakugan in the battle: if defeated, it returns to its owner's hand instead of being eliminated

brise-muraille.name: Wall Breaker
brise-muraille.description: Nullifies the opposing Gate Card and forbids setting a new one on that slot for 2 turns

ancre-abyssale.name: Abyssal Anchor
ancre-abyssale.description: Drains 50 Gs from every opposing Bakugan on the field and transfers the total to the user

verdict-du-bourreau.name: Executioner's Verdict
verdict-du-bourreau.description: Condemns an opposing Bakugan anywhere on the field: if the user wins this battle, the target is eliminated

jugement-du-legendaire.name: Legendary Judgement
jugement-du-legendaire.description: Nullifies every ability active on the Gate Card, on both sides: bonuses and penalties alike vanish

oeil-du-cyclone.name: Eye of the Cyclone
oeil-du-cyclone.description: Sends every Bakugan on the Gate Card, allies included, back to its owner's hand; the Gate Card is removed and the battle is cancelled

rafale-ascendante.name: Rising Gust
rafale-ascendante.description: Sends the weakest opposing Bakugan on the Gate Card back to its owner's hand, without eliminating it

brasier-de-siege.name: Siege Blaze
brasier-de-siege.description: Removes 50 Gs from every Bakugan on the Gate Card, allies included; only the user is spared

carapace-reflechissante.name: Reflecting Shell
carapace-reflechissante.description: The next power loss aimed at the user is converted into an equivalent power bonus

enigme-du-sphinx.name: Sphinx's Riddle
enigme-du-sphinx.description: The opponent cannot set any new Bakugan on the field during their next turn

maree-corrosive.name: Corrosive Tide
maree-corrosive.description: Removes 50 Gs from every opponent on the Gate Card and poisons the strongest of them

protocole-d-escorte.name: Escort Protocol
protocole-d-escorte.description: The user takes on the base power level of the strongest allied Bakugan on the field

griffes-affamees.name: Hungering Claws
griffes-affamees.description: Adds 50 Gs to the user, plus 100 Gs for each opposing Bakugan already eliminated in the game

moisson-des-ames.name: Soul Harvest
moisson-des-ames.description: Adds 100 Gs for each eliminated allied Bakugan and 50 Gs for each eliminated opposing Bakugan. While the card is active, the share drawn from allies is given back to Reaper every time it returns to the field; the share taken from opponents does not come back
